approval_evidence.quote: NDA 208471 NDA APPROVAL ... for Adlyxin (lixisenatide) injection 0.05 mg/mL and 0.1 mg/mL. This new drug application provides for the use of Adlyxin (lixisenatide) injection as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in the treatment of adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus. ... It is approved, effective on the date of this letter

launch_evidence.quote: The launch of Lyxumia in the EU began with Germany and the United Kingdom at the end of the first quarter and the roll out is expected to continue over 2013.

series_start_reason: Sanofi's Q1 2013 release says the EU launch of Lyxumia began at the end of the first quarter and prints no Lyxumia sales figure for it; the first printed figure is the Q2 2013 release sentence 'Second-quarter sales of Lyxumia were EUR 1 million'. 2013Q2-2013Q4 are printed in prose only (no table row); the first table row is the Q1 2014 release.
series_end_reason: The Q3 2018 release (accession 0001193125-18-313798) Diabetes table lists Soliqua and Admelog but no Lyxumia row, and no Lyxumia or Adlyxin line appears in the tables of the Q3 2018, Q4 2018, Q1 2019 or Q4 2019 releases. The last printed quarter is Q2 2018 (EUR 6 million).
notes: Series is Sanofi's worldwide 'Lyxumia' line. Sanofi's Form 20-F (FY2016 and FY2018) names the product Lyxumia/Adlyxin (lixisenatide), Adlyxin being the U.S. brand (FDA approval July 2016, U.S. availability from early 2017); the releases do not say whether the Lyxumia row includes U.S. Adlyxin sales, and no separate Adlyxin row exists. Values are whole EUR millions. Full years sum to the printed full-year figure for 2014-2017 (27, 38, 33, 26) and 2013 sums to the printed 2013 figure of 9 (1 + 3 + 5, implying 0 in Q1). Lyxumia is also an ingredient of Soliqua/Suliqua (sanofi_soliqua), which is reported separately.
